conf.description: entra-id provisioning dataset, json format: parsing deferred entirely to the Azure Logs integration (azure.provisioning data stream). Thin pipeline: filters the shared Event Hub feed to the ProvisioningLogs category, normalizes the four-value provisioning status the stock pipeline's event.outcome derivation gets wrong for skipped/warning, and tags event.dataset.

conf.comment: entra-id / provisioning / json: single ProvisioningLogs diagnostic category on the same Event Hub as the other three datasets. Parsing (Graph provisioningObjectSummary flattening) is left to the Azure Logs integration -- do not re-implement it. The one actionable field-table transform pre-Elasticsearch is overriding event.outcome so skipped/warning become unknown instead of being folded into failure, since skipped is the dominant steady-state value and would otherwise make the dataset unreadable.

functions.description: document scope: thin pass-through, integration owns ECS mapping
identify the event: keep only the ProvisioningLogs category on this shared Event Hub feed
normalize the four-value provisioning status (success/failure map directly, skipped/warning become unknown) per the field-table transform, and tag event.dataset ahead of the integration's own parsing
